ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The input of the system in the figure is labeled x(t)=m(t)cos(2400πt), after passing through an Amplifier, the output is y(t)=10x(t)+x^2(t), then it enters a bandpass filter whose frequency response is H(f), and the output is z(t). The H(f) figure below shows two rectangular passbands, with gain 1, the positive-frequency passband is from 700 Hz to 1700 Hz, and the negative-frequency passband is from -1700 Hz to -700 Hz. Reasoning: cos(2400πt)=cos(2π·1200t), so x(t) is modulating the low-pass signal m(t) to near ±1200 Hz. If the bandwidth of m(t) is W, then the positive-frequency spectrum of x(t) occupies [1200-W,1200+W], and the negative-frequency spectrum occupies [-1200-W,-1200+W]. In order to let 10x(t) completely pass through H(f), [1200-W,1200+W] needs to be located within [700,1700], therefore W≤500; the negative-frequency end gives the same restriction. But the amplifier output also contains x^2(t). Because x^2(t)=m^2(t)cos^2(2400πt)=m^2(t)/2 + [m^2(t)cos(4800πt)]/2. If the bandwidth of m(t) is W, then the bandwidth of m^2(t) is 2W, therefore x^2(t) contains a baseband component, with support interval [-2W,2W]; it also contains second-harmonic components, centered at ±2400 Hz, with support intervals [2400-2W,2400+2W] and [-2400-2W,-2400+2W]. In order to make z(t)=10x(t), these x^2(t) components cannot enter the filter passbands. The baseband component cannot reach the starting point 700 Hz of the positive-frequency passband, so 2W<700 is needed, that is W<350. The second-harmonic positive-frequency component cannot enter the ending point 1700 Hz of the positive-frequency passband, so 2400-2W>1700 is needed, that is W<350; the negative-frequency end is the same. Combining W≤500 and W<350, the decisive constraint is W<350 Hz. Therefore the maximum numerical value for "should be strictly less than" filled in the problem is 350.

method.method_draft: First identify the carrier in x(t): cos(2400πt)=cos(2π·1200t), so x(t) occupies [1200-W,1200+W] and [-1200-W,-1200+W]. The filter passes [700,1700] and [-1700,-700], so passing 10x(t) requires W<={500}. Next analyze x^2(t): its components are a baseband m^2(t)/2 with support [-2W,2W] and second-harmonic components centered at ±2400 Hz with supports [2400-2W,2400+2W] and [-2400-2W,-2400+2W]. For z(t) to equal only 10x(t), none of these x^2 components may overlap the passbands. The closest constraints are 2W<700 from the baseband not reaching the passband and 2400-2W>1700 from the second harmonic not entering the upper passband; both give W<350. Combine with W≤500, so the maximum value must be strictly less than 350 Hz.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中系统的输入标为 x(t)=m(t)cos(2400πt)，经过一个 Amplifier 后输出 y(t)=10x(t)+x^2(t)，再进入频率响应为 H(f) 的带通滤波器，输出 z(t)。下方 H(f) 图显示两个矩形通带，增益为 1，正频通带从 700 Hz 到 1700 Hz，负频通带从 -1700 Hz 到 -700 Hz。

推理：cos(2400πt)=cos(2π·1200t)，所以 x(t) 是将低通信号 m(t) 调制到 ±1200 Hz 附近。若 m(t) 带宽为 W，则 x(t) 的正频谱占据 [1200-W,1200+W]，负频谱占据 [-1200-W,-1200+W]。为了让 10x(t) 完整通过 H(f)，需 [1200-W,1200+W] 位于 [700,1700] 内，因此 W≤500；负频端给出相同限制。

但放大器输出还包含 x^2(t)。因为 x^2(t)=m^2(t)cos^2(2400πt)=m^2(t)/2 + [m^2(t)cos(4800πt)]/2。若 m(t) 带宽为 W，则 m^2(t) 的带宽为 2W，因此 x^2(t) 含有基带分量，支撑区间为 [-2W,2W]；还含有二次谐波分量，中心在 ±2400 Hz，支撑区间为 [2400-2W,2400+2W] 和 [-2400-2W,-2400+2W]。

为了使 z(t)=10x(t)，这些 x^2(t) 分量不能进入滤波器通带。基带分量不能到达正频通带起点 700 Hz，所以需要 2W<700，即 W<350。二次谐波正频分量不能进入正频通带终点 1700 Hz，所以需要 2400-2W>1700，即 W<350；负频端同理。综合 W≤500 与 W<350，决定性约束为 W<350 Hz。因此题目所填的“应严格小于”的最大数值是 350。
